messages.subject: evaluating a variable inside of aes_string() within reactivePlot()
parts:
I have a ggplot geom_bar() call within a reactive plot.  As part of the plot, I have a call to aes_string() that includes the argument:

fill = 'factor(ifelse(some_vector %in% input$some_setting,2,1))' ## this is to get some bar(s) to take on a different color.

This works fine in plain old R, but for some reason this argument doesn't evaluate properly (it complains that it can't find the variable input$some_setting) within reactivePlot().

Do I need to use eval() in some way to get it to evaluate?

Thanks!
